arguments.command: for f in /app/domains/index/contract.json /app/domains/attributes/contract.json /app/views/table/contract.json /app/inputs/case.json; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

for f in /app/domains/index/model.py /app/domains/index/transform.py /app/domains/index/render.py /app/domains/index/check_module.py /app/domains/attributes/model.py /app/domains/attributes/transform.py /app/domains/attributes/render.py /app/domains/attributes/check_module.py /app/views/table/model.py /app/views/table/transform.py /app/views/table/render.py /app/views/table/check_module.py /app/run_all.py /app/final_report.py; do echo "=== $f ($(wc -c <"$f") bytes) ==="; cat "$f"; done

cat outputs/final_report.json && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, json, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/domains/index'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/domains/attributes'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/views/table')
import importlib.util
def load(name, path):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); return m
idx=load('idx_t','/app/domains/index/transform.py')
att=load('att_t','/app/domains/attributes/transform.py')
tab=load('tab_t','/app/views/table/transform.py')
C=lambda n,i: {'name':n,'operation':'x','inputs':['a']*i,'output':'o'}
# empty input
p={'columns':[],'pieces':[],'attribute_policy':'first'}
assert idx.transform([p],C('index',1))=={'name':'index','result':{'columns':[],'order':[]}}
assert att.transform([p],C('attributes',1))=={'name':'attributes','result':{'attrs':{},'conflicts':[]}}
# first policy keeps first value, conflicts still listed
p2={'columns':['x'],'pieces':[{'id':'a','coordinates':[1],'data':[[5]],'attrs':{'k':'v1'}},{'id':'b','coordinates':[2],'data':[[6]],'attrs':{'k':'v2'}}],'attribute_policy':'first'}
r=att.transform([p2],C('attributes',1))['result']
assert r=={'attrs':{'k':'v1'},'conflicts':['k']}, r
# deep-equal with numeric tolerance
p3={'columns':['x'],'pieces':[{'id':'a','coordinates':[1],'data':[[5]],'attrs':{'k':1}},{'id':'b','coordinates':[2],'data':[[6]],'attrs':{'k':1.0}}],'attribute_policy':'drop_conflicts'}
assert att.transform([p3],C('attributes',1))['result']=={'attrs':{'k':1},'conflicts':[]}
# bool vs 1 not equal
p4={'columns':['x'],'pieces':[{'id':'a','coordinates':[1],'data':[[5]],'attrs':{'k':True}},{'id':'b','coordinates':[2],'data':[[6]],'attrs':{'k':1}}],'attribute_policy':'drop_conflicts'}
assert att.transform([p4],C('attributes',1))['result']=={'attrs':{},'conflicts':['k']}
# table uses upstream order verbatim (unsorted) and both upstream results
up={'name':'index','result':{'columns':['x'],'order':[{'coordinate':2,'piece':'b','row':0},{'coordinate':1,'piece':'a','row':0}]}}
ua={'name':'attributes','result':{'attrs':{'k':'v'},'conflicts':['z']}}
r=tab.transform([copy.deepcopy(p2),up,ua],C('table',3))['result']
assert r=={'coordinates':[2,1],'columns':['x'],'data':[[6],[5]],'attrs':{'k':'v'},'attribute_conflicts':['z']}, r
# errors
for bad in [
  ({'columns':['x'],'pieces':[{'id':'a','coordinates':[1,1],'data':[[1],[2]],'attrs':{}}],'attribute_policy':'first'}),
  ({'columns':['x','x'],'pieces':[],'attribute_policy':'first'}),
  ({'columns':['x'],'pieces':[{'id':'a','coordinates':[1],'data':[[1],[2]],'attrs':{}}],'attribute_policy':'first'}),
  ({'columns':['x'],'pieces':[{'id':'a','coordinates':[1],'data':[[1,2]],'attrs':{}}],'attribute_policy':'first'}),
  ({'columns':['x'],'pieces':[{'id':'a','coordinates':[True],'data':[[1]],'attrs':{}}],'attribute_policy':'first'}),
  ({'columns':['x'],'pieces':[{'id':'a','coordinates':[1],'data':[[1]]}],'attribute_policy':'first'}),
  ({'columns':['x'],'pieces':[],'attribute_policy':'bogus'}),
]:
  try: idx.transform([bad],C('index',1)); assert False, bad
  except ValueError: pass
try: idx.transform([p,p],C('index',1)); assert False
except ValueError: pass
print('EDGE_OK')
EOF

cd /tmp && python3 /app/domains/index/render.py && python3 /app/views/table/render.py && echo CLI_ANY_CWD_OK; cd /app && python3 run_all.py && python3 check.py && cat outputs/table.json | head -20 && sha256sum <(python3 -c "import json;print(json.dumps(json.load(open('outputs/core_manifest.json')),ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False),end='')")
